details:
* OpenJDK 8u514 release, build 1 (jdk8u514-ga == jdk8u514-b01).
     Release notes:
     https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17
     - Security fixes:
       + CVE-2026-114939: security-libs/org.ietf.jgss
       + CVE-2026-114940: security-libs/javax.net.ssl
       + CVE-2026-114943: hotspot/runtime
       + CVE-2026-114944: core-svc/java.lang.management
       + CVE-2026-114946: hotspot/compiler
     - Upstream changes since jdk8u512-b09:
       + JDK-8274205: Handle KDC_ERR_SVC_UNAVAILABLE error code from KDC
       + JDK-8316771: Krb5.java has not defined messages for all error
         codes
       + JDK-8387162: Enhance Kerberos tickets
       + JDK-8389989: Enhance loop handling
       + JDK-8389830: Enhance JFR Events
       + JDK-8391595: [REDO] Enhance JMX Connections
       + JDK-8393456: Improve TLS client connections
       + JDK-8384495, JDK-8393195: Update Libpng to 1.6.59 (bundled copy,
         removed from the orig tarball; system libpng is used)
       + JDK-8394492: Update FreeType to 2.15.0 (bundled copy, removed
         from the orig tarball; system FreeType is used)
   * debian/rules: bump gh_tag to jdk8u514-ga, version_dash_buildnr to
     514-b01. gh_tag_aarch32 is unchanged: no 8u514 aarch32 port tag has
     been published upstream, so hotspot-aarch32 is carried over from the
     previous orig tarball.
   * New orig tarball openjdk-8_8u514-ga.orig.tar.gz generated from the
     upstream jdk8u514-ga tag with the Ubuntu get-orig / dfsg-orig
     procedure (verified to reproduce the Ubuntu 8u512-b09~us1 component
     tarballs file-for-file); icedtea-sound and hotspot-aarch32 carried
     over unchanged.
